arStrings.szText: Purchased from the Altar of the Psyche at the Tree of Whispers.

When you first strike an enemy, it is afflicted with an {c_important}Aura of Lament{/c} that Slows it and other nearby enemies by {c_number}[SF_1*100|x%|]{/c}. For each enemy inside of {c_important}Aura of Lament{/c}, you gain {c_number}[SF_2]{/c} Primary Resource each second. If the initial enemy dies, {c_important}Aura of Lament{/c} is passed onto another nearby enemy retaining the duration. Lasts {c_random}[SF_0]{/c} seconds.

Only {c_number}{SF_13}{/c} {if:SF_11}enemies{else}enemy{/if} may be afflicted at a time. May only occur every {c_number}{SF_10}{/c} seconds.
You may now apply {c_important}Aura of Lament{/c} to {c_number}2{/c} enemies at a time.
